Is This a Reparametrized Distribution?

Source: R/reparametrize.R
is_reparam.Rd

TRUE for either of the two wrapper classes, ReparamContinuousDistrib() and ReparamDiscreteDistrib(), and FALSE for anything else. The test exists because the two classes have different parents, so no single S7_inherits() call answers it.

Usage

is_reparam(distrib)

Arguments

distrib

An object inheriting from distrib, or anything else.

Value

A single logical.

See also

reparametrize(), which builds them; ReparamContinuousDistrib() for the classes.

Examples

d <- reparametrize(
  gaussian1_distrib(),
  map = function(psi) list(mu = psi$mu, sigma = sqrt(psi$sigma2)),
  params = c("mu", "sigma2"),
  bounds = list(mu = c(-Inf, Inf), sigma2 = c(0, Inf)),
  links = list(mu = linkfunctions7::identity_link(),
               sigma2 = linkfunctions7::log_link())
)
c(distributions7:::is_reparam(d),
  distributions7:::is_reparam(gaussian2_distrib()))
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE
